role.title: MLOps Engineer / ML Platform Engineer
role.focus: Infrastructure, automation and platform engineering for reliable machine-learning lifecycle management
role.objective: Build, ship, test and maintain reliable production-grade systems in this specialization.

responsibilities.1: Design and implement infrastructure, automation and platform engineering for reliable machine-learning lifecycle management.
responsibilities.2: Translate requirements into maintainable technical solutions.
responsibilities.3: Write clean, modular and testable code.
responsibilities.4: Work with databases, APIs and production infrastructure relevant to the role.
responsibilities.5: Debug failures using logs, metrics and systematic root-cause analysis.
responsibilities.6: Use Git and collaborative development practices.
responsibilities.7: Automate repetitive engineering and deployment workflows.
responsibilities.8: Apply security, reliability and performance best practices.
responsibilities.9: Document architecture, decisions and operational procedures.
responsibilities.10: Deploy solutions and monitor them in realistic environments.
responsibilities.11: Measure quality and improve systems based on evidence.
responsibilities.12: Collaborate with engineers, product stakeholders and data teams.

qualifications.education: Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, Data or related field; strong equivalent self-learning is acceptable.
qualifications.experience: Projects, internships, open-source contributions or practical engineering work.
qualifications.portfolio: At least 2 substantial projects with documented technical decisions and a deployed or reproducible implementation.

interview_questions.2: How is MLOps different from DevOps?
interview_questions.15: How do you monitor model quality?
interview_questions.22: How do you prevent bad models reaching production?
interview_questions.24: How do you test ML pipelines?
interview_questions.30: How do you reduce inference cost?
interview_questions.34: How do you secure model artifacts?
interview_questions.35: How do you manage API secrets?
interview_questions.36: How do you build reproducible environments?
interview_questions.41: How do retries affect ML workflows?
interview_questions.42: How do you handle failed training jobs?
interview_questions.43: How do you manage GPU resources?
interview_questions.44: How do you optimize model deployment?
interview_questions.45: How would you build a model platform?
interview_questions.46: How would you design continuous training?
interview_questions.47: How would you design a model rollback system?
interview_questions.48: How would you detect production model degradation?
interview_questions.50: How do you balance reliability, cost and developer velocity?

1.name: End-to-End ML Platform
1.description: Build a platform that ingests versioned data, runs reproducible training, tracks experiments, registers approved models and deploys them through automated CI/CD.

2.name: Continuous Training Pipeline
2.description: Build scheduled data validation, training, evaluation and approval workflows with automatic rollback when quality gates fail.

3.name: Model Observability Platform
3.description: Build monitoring for prediction latency, errors, input drift, output distribution and model quality, with alerts and investigation dashboards.
